g.text: Does blocking beat ikj? Not at n = 128 or 256 in this run.
Archived CPU measurements, 2026-10-27 | 75 records | 5 timed samples per configuration
Speed relative to ikj = median(ikj time) / algorithm time; larger is faster
Dots: all samples; line: min-max; black tick + label: ratio of medians. Ranges are not confidence intervals.
Each panel uses its own ikj median. At n=64 the ranges overlap. Clearing C is included in timing.
Archived executable/source match and exact compiler flags remain unverified; this is not NPU performance.
